name: tmp117
label: TI TMP117: high-accuracy temperature
description:
The 16-bit temperature result at 7.8125 m°C per LSB, CONFIGURATION, the alert limits, the
temperature offset (an offset the DUT writes is added to the result, as on the part) and the
device ID (0x0117). The part converts continuously from power on, so CONFIGURATION's
Data_Ready flag (bit 13) always reads 1 and drivers that wait for it go on at once. A soft reset
(CONFIGURATION bit 1) reloads the power-on image. The alert flags, the one-shot timing and the
EEPROM are not modeled: EEPROM writes are stored and read back, nothing is persisted.
